claim: AWS states that, even with query optimization and schema design, the data retrieval speed from disk plus the added query processing time generally puts database query response times in double-digit millisecond speeds, at best. This assumes a steady load and a database performing optimally.

evidence.quote: Slow processing queries: While there are a number of query optimization techniques and schema designs that can help boost query performance, the data retrieval speed from disk plus the added query processing times generally will put your query response times in double-digit millisecond speeds, at best. This assumes you have a steady load and your database is performing optimally.
